moon_shard.name: Moon Shard
moon_shard.desc: A sliver of the moon's crystal. Found only up there.

pelt.name: Pelt
pelt.desc: Soft fur. Rook buys these; tailors want them.

meat.name: Game Meat
meat.desc: From the hills. Cook it for more.

arrow.name: Arrow
arrow.desc: Rook's fletching. For the bow, when there is one.

flour.name: Flour
flour.desc: Milled at the lake. Posy pays well for it.

candy.name: Candy
candy.desc: The kids will do anything for this.

old_coin.name: Old Coin
old_coin.desc: Dug up somewhere it shouldn't have been.

fossil.name: Fossil
fossil.desc: A fish from before the lake.

hay.name: Hay
hay.desc: Scythe tall grass to get it.

bone.name: Bone
bone.desc: From the mine. The dog approves.

glow_cap.name: Glow Cap
glow_cap.desc: A mushroom that lights the night.

starflower.name: Starflower
starflower.desc: Only grows where the crystal fell.

trap.name: Trap
trap.desc: Rook's design. Catches critters for pelts.

heart_fruit.name: Heart Fruit
heart_fruit.desc: Grows on the oldest trees. +10 max health, forever.

stamina_root.name: Stamina Root
stamina_root.desc: Dug from the hills. +10 max energy, forever.

old_collar.name: Old Collar
old_collar.desc: Leather, chewed, a brass tag worn smooth. BISCUIT.

brass_locket.name: Brass Locket
brass_locket.desc: Two boys on a dock. It hums near crystals.

knight_shard.name: Knight's Shard
knight_shard.desc: Warm, heavy. Your sword hand stops aching.

manifest.name: Shipping Manifest
manifest.desc: Every crate marked with a purple crystal. UPTOWN, TOWER, SUB-BASEMENT 3.

litter_box.name: Litter Box
litter_box.desc: Cat-topia's secret weapon. Throw it: every Grump nearby stops to hold its nose.

finargle_fuzz.name: Finargle Fuzz
finargle_fuzz.desc: Black and warm and it hums faintly in your pack. Spies' leavings.

sacred_key.name: Sacred Key
sacred_key.desc: Coldy's key to the heart of Mount Prismatica. It is warm, and it is humming.

merkitty_necklace.name: Merkitty Necklace
merkitty_necklace.desc: Glows blue-green in the dark. You grow a tail the moment you touch water.
